user.title: Alexa Room Sync
user.description: Pick the Alexa Media Player account whose Alexa rooms should mirror your Home Assistant areas.

abort.no_alexa_media: No Alexa Media Player account is configured. Install and log in to Alexa Media Player first — this integration reuses its session.
abort.already_configured: This Alexa account is already set up.

settings.title: Alexa Room Sync options
settings.description: By default nothing is written to Alexa. To let the sync create rooms, turn OFF dry-run and turn ON the write confirmation.

data.confirmed_not_dry_run: I understand 'apply' will write to my Alexa account

skip.name: Rooms to skip
skip.description: These areas never get an Alexa room from a full sync. Running sync_area on one of them still works.

remove_rooms.title: Remove managed rooms from Alexa
remove_rooms.description: Deletes the Alexa rooms this integration created. A room that also holds something you added yourself, like an Echo, is kept with just those devices. Groups you made yourself are never touched. Removing the integration on its own does not change Alexa.

data.confirm: Yes, remove the rooms from Alexa

sync_area.title: Sync one area
sync_area.description: Brings the Alexa room for one HA area in line: creates it, or updates its devices and name. Other rooms aren't touched, and this works even for an area on the skip list. Leave Apply off to see what would change first.

error.writes_not_confirmed: Writes aren't enabled. Tick "I understand 'apply' will write to my Alexa account" in Settings first.
